PG1.quote: Every test and every request fails with `LoadError: cannot load such file -- pagy/extras/items` ... `@pagy.items` no longer exists in 9.x, so `GET /notes` would raise `NoMethodError` ... Pagy::DEFAULT[:limit] = 10 / Pagy::DEFAULT[:limit_param] = :per_page / Pagy::DEFAULT[:limit_max] = 50 ... change it to `@pagy.limit`.
PG1.reasons: Validation: the plan relies on existing tests for the 500→50 cap, per_page=5 selection and a default-10 control. It leaves out the asymmetric owned, filter-excluded and foreign dataset, following the actual Next href (positions 6–10 then 11–15), the size-25 last page, exact retained filter queries, /journal, empty search, the foreign 404 and the anonymous redirect.

PG2.quote: `GET /notes?page=` (blank), `page=0`, `page=-1` and `page=two` now raise `Pagy::VariableError` ... which users see as a 500 ... def pagy_get_page(vars, **) [super.to_i, 1].max end ... Probe on both versions ... control check ... `per_page=50&page=9` still falls back to the last page
PG2.reasons: Validation: the plan has invalid-page probes and tests on both versions, plus page-2 and stale-page controls. It does not include filtering or ownership controls, and it does not explicitly compare each invalid input with page-one content alongside valid first/next/last pages.
